theater_event_23_01_01_014: Haruhime, Mikoto! Are you all right?!
theater_event_23_01_01_015: Y-yes... I'm fine, thanks to Lady Mikoto...
theater_event_23_01_01_016:
Everyone, be careful! There are more coming!
No—
they're spawning one after another...!!
theater_event_23_01_01_017:
A Monster Party...!
We'll get surrounded if we stay here!
theater_event_23_01_01_018:
Let's retreat! I'll open an escape route with
a magic sword! Lady Mikoto, Mr. Welf, take
point!
theater_event_23_01_01_019: Mr. Bell, please cover the rear!
theater_event_23_01_01_021: Everyone, I am so terribly sorry—!
theater_event_23_01_01_022:
Even veteran adventurers can get caught off
guard by an ambush from behind. There was
nothing to be done about today...
theater_event_23_01_01_023:
That's right, none of this was your fault,
Haruhime. If anything, I'm sorry I was so
slow to back you up.
theater_event_23_01_01_024:
But... ever since you let me join your
expeditions, all I've done is have
everyone protect me...
theater_event_23_01_01_025:
Well, it's simply a fact that Lili and Lady
Haruhime are no use whatsoever in a fight.
theater_event_23_01_01_027:
There's still a lot you're not used to...
Let's take it slow and build up experience
properly from the back line.
theater_event_23_01_01_029:
Well then, since we're at it, why don't we
hold today's debriefing right here?
theater_event_23_01_01_030:
Then I'll say it.
Lil' E, you're way too trigger-happy with
those magic swords.
theater_event_23_01_01_031:
Not at all! In that situation,
it was the optimal solution!
theater_event_23_01_01_032:
Still, if you're gonna toss 'em around
like they're nothing...
theater_event_23_01_02_035:
...I will follow you. I wish to be
of help to all of you.
theater_event_23_01_02_037:
...Even though I swore that before everyone,
as I am now, I am of no use to anyone...
theater_event_23_01_02_038:
Lady Haruhime, please don't be so down.
As Lady Lili said, the rest of us will
handle the fighting...
theater_event_23_01_02_039:
But... Lady Lili has experience and wisdom.
She contributes to the party by giving
precise orders from the rear.
theater_event_23_01_02_040:
Master Welf, Lady Mikoto, and Master Bell
too... Each of you shines doing what only you
can do.
theater_event_23_01_02_041:
And yet I only ever hold everyone back...
When all I want is to be of use...
theater_event_23_01_02_042:
—Nobody gets things right at first.
I myself failed constantly when I started
out.
theater_event_23_01_02_044:
As long as you survive... That is the iron
rule
of every adventurer.
theater_event_23_01_02_045:
By surviving...and building, one by one, on
everything I gained in the Dungeon, I became
who I am today.
theater_event_23_01_02_046:
I'm sure it was the same for Sir Bell and Sir
Welf... They became upper-tier adventurers
through training and adventure.
theater_event_23_01_02_048:
So don't let it get you down.
Let's steadily gain experience together.
theater_event_23_01_02_049:
Y-yes... You are quite right, Lady Mikoto...!
What matters is training and adventure...!
theater_event_23_01_02_050:
If I cannot do anything as I am now,
then I need only work hard until I can...!
theater_event_23_01_02_051:
Yes. You could train every day, or head out
in your free time to do some leveling...
theater_event_23_01_02_052:
Leveling...! Lady Mikoto!
I should like to try some leveling!
theater_event_23_01_02_053:
Yes, it'd be a good chance to earn excelia
while learning how to handle the Dungeon!
theater_event_23_01_02_054: Then, Lady Mikoto! I shall be off!
theater_event_23_01_02_057:
—W-wait just a moment, Lady Haruhimeee!
Not now! We only just got back from an
expedition!
theater_event_23_01_02_058:
Besides, leveling isn't something
you do alone.
theater_event_23_01_02_059:
It's meant to be done under the supervision
of a senior adventurer, for both safety
and guidance.
theater_event_23_01_02_060:
Tomorrow! Rest well tonight,
and we'll go together tomorrow!
theater_event_23_01_02_061:
Ohh... But I wish to become useful
to everyone as soon as possible...
theater_event_23_01_02_062:
Rest is part of training, too.
As they say, "More haste, less speed."
theater_event_23_01_02_064:
Ah, then at least...
may I start preparing for tomorrow now?
theater_event_23_01_02_065: Well, I suppose that much is fine...
theater_event_23_01_02_066:
Let me see, first I shall check my
backpack...
theater_event_23_01_02_067:
Potions, naturally,
and plenty of towels and tissues...
theater_event_23_01_02_068:
Oh, and perhaps some sweets as well?
I was told I may buy anything up to 100
valis—
theater_event_23_01_02_069:
...Maybe we should consult Lady Lili first
and have her pick out your supplies...
theater_event_23_01_03_076:
It's going to counterattack!
Don't take your eyes off the enemy!
theater_event_23_01_03_078:
Eeek! Ow, ow, it hurts!
Please stay awaaay!
theater_event_23_01_03_080:
Ohh... I am so sorry...
In the end, you had to rescue me...
theater_event_23_01_03_081: No, that's what I'm here for...
theater_event_23_01_03_082:
Is this sorry display
even counting as leveling...?
theater_event_23_01_03_083:
It is!
...Probably. Most likely. Sort of...
theater_event_23_01_03_084:
At least taking hits from the goblin should
raise your Endurance Status... I think...
theater_event_23_01_03_085:
Y-yes, of course...!
I must not give up...!
theater_event_23_01_03_087:
...! This time I shall defeat it!
Hyaaaaaaah!
theater_event_23_01_03_089:
Eeeeeeei!
—Ah, my weapon slipped out of my haaands?!
theater_event_23_01_03_091:
Ahh! Ow, it hurts!
Please stop pummeling meee!
theater_event_23_01_03_094:
I'm so sorry...
You had to rescue me again...
theater_event_23_01_03_095: No, really, please don't worry about it...
theater_event_23_01_03_096:
But surely I'm gaining experience little by
little...! I must devote myself even more...!
theater_event_23_01_03_098:
—Ah, a goblin!
I shall go fight it once more!
theater_event_23_01_03_099:
—Wait, rocks?! Please don't throw rocks!
That hurts! That's not fair!
theater_event_23_01_03_100:
Yes, taking hits is important too...!
Getting hurt is also valuable experience...!
theater_event_23_01_03_101:
But I jump in to help far too soon...!
That won't do Lady Haruhime any good...!
theater_event_23_01_03_103:
She's still okay! Still okay...!
No matter how painful it is, I must hold
back...!
theater_event_23_01_04_107:
There, all clean... Good.
Does anything else hurt?
theater_event_23_01_04_108:
No, I'm all right.
Thank you very much.
theater_event_23_01_04_109:
...Really? You're not hiding any injuries
so I won't worry, are you...?
theater_event_23_01_04_114: Oh, I was just remembering the old days...
theater_event_23_01_04_115:
The old days... You mean back in the Far
East?
theater_event_23_01_04_116:
Yes. The time you, Master Ouka, Lady Chigusa,
and the others snuck me out of the mansion.
theater_event_23_01_04_117:
Running around the hills with all of you
was such fun...
theater_event_23_01_04_118:
Back then, too, you looked after me when I
scraped my leg, unused to mountain walking.
theater_event_23_01_04_119:
You said Lord Takemikazuchi taught you,
and you picked medicinal herbs to treat me...
theater_event_23_01_04_121:
Thinking back on it now,
perhaps nothing has changed since then...
theater_event_23_01_04_122:
The one who takes my hand and leads me off
on adventures...has always been you, Mikoto.
theater_event_23_01_04_124:
...Yes, that's right.
Now and then, nothing has changed.
theater_event_23_01_04_125:
I will protect you, Lady Haruhime.
No matter what.
theater_event_23_01_04_127:
...Now then, what to do?
That was the last of your potions...
theater_event_23_01_04_128: Shall we call it a day?
theater_event_23_01_04_129:
U-um...
Might I try a little longer...?
theater_event_23_01_04_130:
I've recovered, and I can still fight.
So just a little longer...
theater_event_23_01_04_131:
Hmm... Let's see...
There is still time before sunset...
theater_event_23_01_04_132: Then please hold on to this.
theater_event_23_01_04_133:
A potion?
But isn't this yours, Lady Mikoto...?
theater_event_23_01_04_134:
I brought it out of habit, but it doesn't
look like I'll need it. I'll leave it with
you, so let's keep going a little longer.
theater_event_23_01_04_136:
And I will harden my heart!
I'll do my best not to jump in!
theater_event_23_01_04_138: Then, let's go find a monster at once—
theater_event_23_01_04_140:
...I-I'm terribly sorry...
All that moving around seems to have
made me hungry...
theater_event_23_01_04_141:
Ah ha ha... Potions don't do much
for an empty stomach, after all...
theater_event_23_01_04_142:
Actually... I made a boxed lunch.
Would you care for some, Lady Mikoto...?
theater_event_23_01_04_143:
Oh, really? I'd love some!
I've already scored the walls, so let's eat
here.
theater_event_23_01_05_147:
...How was it...?
I tried my very best...
theater_event_23_01_05_148:
Well... Let's see...
Um, hmm, how to put it...
theater_event_23_01_05_149:
P-please give me your honest opinion!
I shall use it to improve!
theater_event_23_01_05_150:
Overall it was a bit...sweet and salty?
Maybe the seasoning ratio...?
theater_event_23_01_05_152:
Ohh... I'm useless not only in battle,
but in housework too...!
theater_event_23_01_05_153:
Ah, no...! It's not like it was
inedible or anything...!
theater_event_23_01_05_154:
In fact, considering you only started cooking
recently, you could call it remarkable
growth...!
theater_event_23_01_05_156:
Yes! If you keep this up, I'm sure you'll
make food everyone... I mean, Sir Bell will
love...
theater_event_23_01_05_157:
M-M-M-Master Bell?!
Oh, I couldn't possibly presume...!
theater_event_23_01_05_158: But if I were allowed... if by some chance...
theater_event_23_01_05_159:
Ah, no, I mustn't!
Master Bell feeding me, saying "Say aah"?!
theater_event_23_01_05_160:
Why not? Your cooking is so delicious,
Haruhime...
I want you to taste it yourself.
theater_event_23_01_05_161:
B-but that's no reason for you to go
out of your way to say "Say aah"...!
theater_event_23_01_05_162:
Heh...
You really are a funny one, Haruhime.
theater_event_23_01_05_163:
Obviously, because when I say "Say aah," it
tastes a hundred trillion times better than
when I don't...
theater_event_23_01_05_164:
I-I'm starting to feel that might be so...
Ah, but no! Someone like me shouldn't—!
theater_event_23_01_05_165:
Hush now, okay? Right now, your mouth exists
only to accept my "Say aah"...
theater_event_23_01_05_172:
Find your motivation wherever you like,
but... please don't drift off to strange
places in the middle of the Dungeon!
theater_event_23_01_05_174:
...Well, now that we've eaten,
let's do one more round of leveling—
theater_event_23_01_05_177:
Lady Haruhime, get behind me.
I sense something unpleasant—
theater_event_23_01_06_185:
On the 5th floor...! A whole bunch
of orcs, all of a sudden...!
theater_event_23_01_06_186:
A Monster Party...?!
No... did they come up from below?!
theater_event_23_01_06_187:
I-I was just running for my life...!
Before I knew it, I was all alone...!
theater_event_23_01_06_188:
—!
Then your party is still down there...?!
theater_event_23_01_06_189: I-I'm not going back down there!
theater_event_23_01_06_190:
I'll report to the Guild and get them to send
help... S-sorry, but I'm heading up...
theater_event_23_01_06_192:
If Level 1 adventurers get surrounded
by a horde of orcs...!
theater_event_23_01_06_193: L-Lady Mikoto! We must go help them!
theater_event_23_01_06_194:
Yes... Help from the surface probably won't
make it in time... But...!
theater_event_23_01_06_197: Th-then I shall come with you!
theater_event_23_01_06_200:
A single orc can be handled even at Level 1,
but their attacks are not to be
underestimated.
theater_event_23_01_06_201:
If it were just escorting you between the
Dungeon and the surface, that'd be one
thing...
theater_event_23_01_06_202:
But protecting you and who knows how many
stranded adventurers while cutting through an
orc horde? I'm not confident I can do that—!
theater_event_23_01_06_205: This is... a Molbul stink bag...!
theater_event_23_01_06_206:
When I asked Lady Lili about supplies
yesterday,
she gave it to me "just in case."
theater_event_23_01_06_207:
...Return to the surface on your own. With
this, you can safely drive off any monster on
these floors.
theater_event_23_01_06_208:
Head straight for the surface.
Now, I'm off—!
theater_event_23_01_06_211:
...It's all right. Lady Mikoto will be fine
alone.
I would only get in her way...!
theater_event_23_01_06_212:
I need only do as I was told and go up...
It's fine, I have the Molbul, and potions
too...
theater_event_23_01_06_213:
—! This... this potion...
Lady Mikoto gave it to me...!
theater_event_23_01_06_214:
Could it be Lady Mikoto doesn't have a single
potion...? If she's caught in a Monster Party
like that...
theater_event_23_01_06_216: This is...no time to be trembling.
theater_event_23_01_06_217: That's right... I must bring it to her...!
theater_event_23_01_07_221:
(Somehow I've made it this far without the
monsters noticing me, but I must hurry and
find Lady Mikoto...!)
theater_event_23_01_07_224: Stay back! Stay back, stay back, stay baaack!
theater_event_23_01_07_227:
(Orcs...! They really did come up
from the floors below...!)
theater_event_23_01_07_237: Wh-what was that you just threw...?!
theater_event_23_01_07_238:
Um... a special stink bag...
that monsters can't stand...
theater_event_23_01_07_239:
Th-thanks... You saved me...!
I lost my weapon, my gear, everything...
theater_event_23_01_07_241:
We all scattered... I don't know what
happened to 'em. There were three others
besides me... Urgh!
theater_event_23_01_07_244:
It's all right...! We'll make it...!
It's all right...!
theater_event_23_01_07_245:
A comrade of mine, an upper-tier adventurer,
came to this floor ahead of me. If we can meet
up with her, your companions are sure to be...!
theater_event_23_01_07_246:
Now, let us go.
Just hold on a little longer...!
theater_event_23_01_07_247:
(I'm scared... but...!
I must protect him and reach Lady Mikoto...!)
theater_event_23_01_08_250:
O-orcs?! Damn it...!
Please... give me a break already...!
theater_event_23_01_08_252:
I-it's all right!
I-I'm... I'm right here with you...!
theater_event_23_01_08_253: Now, on to the next room—
theater_event_23_01_08_255:
Orcs ahead...!
No good, we must turn back and find another
way—
theater_event_23_01_08_257: H-hey... they're coming from behind too...!
theater_event_23_01_08_259:
They've noticed us...!
And I have no Molbul left...
theater_event_23_01_08_260: Damn it...! So this is it...!
theater_event_23_01_08_263:
Y-you've done enough! We're the ones who
screwed up... At least you get out of
here...!
theater_event_23_01_08_268: I'm right here! Come and get me!
theater_event_23_01_08_276:
I will not run anymore...!
I will not abandon anyone...! I will not give
up!
theater_event_23_01_08_278:
Even when a terrifying enemy lies in wait, a
"hero" goes to fight! I've always admired
heroes like that, and we'll protect you!!
theater_event_23_01_08_280:
No matter how many times you refuse, I'll
take
you out into the world, just like back then.
theater_event_23_01_08_282:
The two who rescued me never gave up,
no matter what hardships stood before
them...!
theater_event_23_01_08_283:
So I will not give up either!
I will protect him, no matter what!!
theater_event_23_01_09_288:
(I'm almost out of potions...!
And he's nearly at his limit...!)
theater_event_23_01_09_289:
(But I won't give up. I can still use
my own body as a shield—!)
theater_event_23_01_09_296:
I came looking for where the orcs were
gathering,
and... What are you doing on this floor?!
theater_event_23_01_09_297:
I-I...! I came to bring you a potion...!
And then I found someone being attacked
by orcs...!
theater_event_23_01_09_298:
Wha—there were other survivors...!
Then that's everyone...!
theater_event_23_01_09_300: Yeah, this lady here saved us, somehow...
theater_event_23_01_09_301:
Now all that's left is to get back to the
surface—
theater_event_23_01_09_305:
Three wounded, and Lady Haruhime... Fighting
this
many while protecting everyone would be...
theater_event_23_01_09_308:
Let us head straight for the stairs up...!
It means you'll have to clear the way ahead,
but...
theater_event_23_01_09_309:
You can find the path with the fewest
monsters
without fail, Lady Mikoto!
theater_event_23_01_09_310:
I'll take the rear—I'll protect the
wounded...! So let's not give up, and get to
the surface...!
theater_event_23_01_09_312:
Yes... You're right.
This is far from the time to give up.
theater_event_23_01_09_313:
Lady Haruhime, let's work together
and break through!
theater_event_23_01_09_316:
Lady Haruhime, give everyone the rest of the
potions. ...Now, then—
theater_event_23_01_10_320:
Everyone! We're almost there!
Keep going!
theater_event_23_01_10_324:
Thank you... Thank you so much...!
I don't even know how to thank you...!
theater_event_23_01_10_325:
N-no... I was simply desperate...
If you wish to thank anyone, thank Lady
Mikoto...
theater_event_23_01_10_326:
Y-you guys...! You're okay...!!
You two saved them...? Thank you, really...!!
theater_event_23_01_10_327:
I'm glad it didn't come to the worst.
Now, let's treat those wounds.
theater_event_23_01_10_328:
...Hey, Renard lady.
I'm gonna be a cool adventurer like you.
Seriously, thanks!
theater_event_23_01_10_330:
I-I still have a long way to go... But it
does
make me happy.
theater_event_23_01_10_331:
—Still, I meant for this to be simple
leveling,
and it turned into quite the adventure...
theater_event_23_01_10_335:
Disobeying my instructions was still
unacceptable! You have no idea how shocked I
was to see you down on that floor...
theater_event_23_01_10_336: Please... don't make me worry like that...
theater_event_23_01_10_341:
You ran off alone without a single potion...
Do you know how worried I was?!
theater_event_23_01_10_342:
Sure, I'm weak, and I'm dead weight... but
I want to do what I can for you too,
Mikoto...!
theater_event_23_01_10_345:
That was thoughtless of me... Just as I care
about you, you care about me too...
theater_event_23_01_10_346:
...I should have trusted you as my comrade
and gone together.
theater_event_23_01_10_347:
And then I shamelessly scolded you.
Please, accept my apology.
theater_event_23_01_10_348:
...Ah, no, I didn't, I didn't mean it like...
Please lift your head.
theater_event_23_01_10_349:
I'm...sorry too!
For not listening to you, Mikoto—!
theater_event_23_01_10_351:
So we're even...right?
Come on, Mikoto!
theater_event_23_01_10_355:
Nothing... It's just the exact opposite of
what I remember from when we were little.
theater_event_23_01_10_356:
Being led by the hand by you...
It's a warm feeling.
theater_event_23_01_10_357:
Oh!
Maybe that's how I felt when you led me,
too...
theater_event_23_01_10_358:
—So she's no longer someone who only
needs protecting, huh...
theater_event_23_01_10_360:
No, it's nothing.
...May I leave the lead to you for today?
theater_event_23_02_01_014:
Yo. You entering too?
Better brace yourself, 'cause I'm gonna
flatten ya.
theater_event_23_02_01_015:
That's my line. You stole the jump on me in
the Dungeon the other day. Time to pay you
back!
theater_event_23_02_01_016: ...That's quite a crowd. What's all the fuss?
theater_event_23_02_01_017:
The Ganesha Familia is hosting
a sumo tournament!
theater_event_23_02_01_018:
You know, that Far Eastern martial art
Gareth loves.
theater_event_23_02_01_019:
...Ah, I see.
So that's why Gareth's been in such a good
mood.
theater_event_23_02_01_020:
Aye. Puts real spirit into my stomping
drills.
My body's itching for it already!
theater_event_23_02_01_021:
Okay, everyone! We'll now explain the
tournament. Please gather over here!
theater_event_23_02_01_022:
Hah! Thrusts, shoves, overarm throws—
I'll show 'em the finest arts of sumo!
theater_event_23_02_01_023: Come on, you lot, let's go!
theater_event_23_02_01_024: Ha ha... He's really enjoying himself.
theater_event_23_02_01_025:
Yep! He's been like that the whole time!
Now I'm getting excited too!
theater_event_23_02_01_026:
But... if you two are entering, it'll be
a one-sided tournament unless a serious
rival shows up.
theater_event_23_02_02_030:
Without further ado, let us explain the
Orario Grand Sumo Tournament!
theater_event_23_02_02_031:
Our special advisor, Lord Takemikazuchi—
if you please.
theater_event_23_02_02_032:
Thank you for gathering, brave warriors of
Orario. I look forward to this tournament.
theater_event_23_02_02_033:
Oh-ho... Putting a true Far Eastern war god
in charge. The Ganesha Familia know their
stuff.
theater_event_23_02_02_034:
Sumo... Many of you in Orario may not be
familiar with it. But the rules are simple.
theater_event_23_02_02_035:
Face off bare-handed. Push your opponent out
of the ring or make them touch the ground,
and you win. That's all.
theater_event_23_02_02_036:
That's the same thing I always do with
Gareth!
theater_event_23_02_02_037:
Of course it is.
Though that simplicity is what gives it
depth.
theater_event_23_02_02_038:
Exactly. It began long ago as a contest of
skill between gods, and is sometimes even
called a "sacred rite."
theater_event_23_02_02_039:
Without heart, skill, and body all in
harmony, you can't survive in a ring with
nowhere to run.
theater_event_23_02_02_040:
So it could come down to more than whose
Status is better, eh? Wouldn't be fun
otherwise.
theater_event_23_02_02_041:
Hmm, but from the looks of it, the only one
who seems strong is Gareth...
theater_event_23_02_02_047:
Not just "Elgarm"... but the "Warlord" too?!
Hey! Are you serious...?
theater_event_23_02_02_048:
What? You scared?
It's not like it's a fight to the death.
theater_event_23_02_02_049:
There might be a big upset, you know.
Plus, beat those guys and you're the talk of
the town overnight... Let's do this!
theater_event_23_02_02_051:
Now then, participants, finish registering
promptly and train hard until the big day.
theater_event_23_02_02_052:
Sumo is not about taking lives!
Everyone, enjoy the matches to the fullest!
theater_event_23_02_02_054: Who'd have thought even Ottar would enter...
theater_event_23_02_02_055:
Gahahaha! Now this is worth entering for!
Tiona, back home—you're my sparring partner.
theater_event_23_02_02_056: Yeah! I'm gonna go all out!
theater_event_23_02_03_058:
O-okay... This is where...
all those monsters showed up last time.
theater_event_23_02_03_060:
This tremor...
Could it be a Monster Party?!
theater_event_23_02_03_061:
Huh? But... the shaking's kind of regular...
Isn't something weird about it?
theater_event_23_02_03_063:
A man's voice... no, a roar?
This is—
theater_event_23_02_03_069: Could the tremors we felt earlier be...
theater_event_23_02_03_073:
S-Sir "Warlord"...?
Why would a first-tier adventurer such as
yourself be on the upper floors...?
theater_event_23_02_03_079:
...Aren't you adventurers from the Far East?
If so, I thought you might know sumo...
theater_event_23_02_03_080: U-um... We are from the Far East, but...
theater_event_23_02_03_081:
I-I can tell you what I know, if you don't
mind something we only dabbled in as kids,
playing with Sir Ouka and the others...
theater_event_23_02_03_083:
Y-yes... What Lord Takemikazuchi taught us
was not to rely on strength, but to unbalance
your opponent and throw them with the flow...
theater_event_23_02_03_087:
Wh-what was that about...? He was like Sakata
no Kintoki, who wrestled sumo with a bear...
theater_event_23_02_03_088:
This isn't...Mount Ashigara.
It's the Dungeon, Mikoto...
theater_event_23_02_04_089:
There was this crazy rumbling, see?
I thought a floor boss had shown up!
theater_event_23_02_04_090:
Nah, nah. That was worse than a floor boss.
He was chucking monsters left and right
barehanded...
theater_event_23_02_04_091: Ha ha... He's the talk of the town now.
theater_event_23_02_04_092:
Sumo practice against monsters... Hahah!
He's really going for it. That fires me up
too.
theater_event_23_02_04_093:
Gareth, you've been doing that "shiko" thing
nonstop, too. You're still going?
theater_event_23_02_04_094:
Aye, shiko is the foundation of sumo.
Only once you have an unshakable lower body
can sumo truly—
theater_event_23_02_04_095:
Ugh, okay, I get it already!
No more complicated stuff!
theater_event_23_02_04_096:
You don't get it at all, do you?
Now, shiko is, at its root—
theater_event_23_02_04_097:
...He's really into it.
Well, it seems like good training, so I don't
mind...
theater_event_23_02_04_100:
If the "Warlord" is entering, surely
your blood is stirring at least a little?
theater_event_23_02_04_101:
...I'd be lying if I said it wasn't, I
suppose.
But unfortunately, I don't have the time—
theater_event_23_02_04_105:
Here, I'll teach you too.
Come over here.
theater_event_23_02_04_107:
...Back to the subject. Surely the "Warlord,"
who leads the Freya Familia, is just as short
on time?
theater_event_23_02_04_108:
Ha ha, well, yes.
Guess that's not much of an excuse...
theater_event_23_02_04_109:
Another reason is that it's too "light" a
stage
for the two of us to settle things.
theater_event_23_02_04_110:
He and I both carry too much to simply
compete as individual adventurers.
theater_event_23_02_04_111:
So the "Warlord" had a reason to enter
that outweighs all that...
theater_event_23_02_04_112:
Yes, that's what I can't believe.
The way he's throwing himself into it...
I am curious what's going on.
theater_event_23_02_04_113:
...Then why not ask him yourself?
That sound is coming from the forest, isn't
it?
theater_event_23_02_04_114:
Ha ha... I seriously doubt he'll give me the
time of day... But without a chance like
this, I'd never talk to him at all...
theater_event_23_02_05_120:
You're the talk of Rivira. They say the
"Warlord" might destroy the Dungeon.
theater_event_23_02_05_121:
...Apparently it's normally done against a
tree.
theater_event_23_02_05_123:
Teppo: sliding in and striking with an open
palm ...a method to train forward drive. But
a mere tree can't withstand my Status...
theater_event_23_02_05_124:
I see. So you're adapting the Far Eastern
training Gareth mentioned in your own way.
theater_event_23_02_05_126:
Nothing... I was just curious.
I heard you were entering the sumo
tournament.
theater_event_23_02_05_127:
I can't see what the "strongest in the city"
gains by entering, and a lively event like
that hardly seems your style.
theater_event_23_02_05_129:
No need to be so wary. It's an honest
question. Your "out of character" behavior
just piqued my curiosity.
theater_event_23_02_05_130:
...I have no answer that would satisfy
your curiosity.
theater_event_23_02_05_132:
Still, sumo is a strange martial art. It
ought to be a primitive, fundamental contest
of strength—
theater_event_23_02_05_133:
And yet it captivates skilled warriors like
Gareth and you. No—it feels like even technique
and tactics are just one element of it.
theater_event_23_02_05_134: Is that the allure that drew you in, too?
theater_event_23_02_05_135:
...No amount of words would let
you understand it.
theater_event_23_02_05_138:
Even in practice, if I faced you head-on...
I probably couldn't hold myself back.
theater_event_23_02_05_139:
That's fine. Competing with everything you
have...
Apparently that is what sumo is.
theater_event_23_02_05_140:
It's a tempting offer, but another time.
I already declared to my comrades that
I wouldn't fight.
theater_event_23_02_05_141:
Sorry to have bothered you.
I wish you luck.
theater_event_23_02_06_144:
...A sumo tournament, hm?
An odd idea, though very like Ganesha.
theater_event_23_02_06_146:
No need to be so on guard. With you at my
side, no one would be reckless enough to try
anything.
theater_event_23_02_06_147: Though if they did...it might be amusing.
theater_event_23_02_06_148:
...Hedin and the others will stand guard
at the venue. Please rest assured.
theater_event_23_02_06_150:
But it's strange... you taking interest in
such a diversion. ...Oh, is "that boy"
entering too?
theater_event_23_02_06_151:
No... Bell Cranel is struggling to break out
of his shell. He has no room to look
elsewhere.
theater_event_23_02_06_152:
I see...
Then all the more, why you?
theater_event_23_02_06_153:
There's no adventurer in Orario today
who could be your match, is there?
theater_event_23_02_06_156:
If you would watch... That's all I can say
now.
theater_event_23_02_06_159:
Very well, I'll play along
with your "out of character" scheme.
theater_event_23_02_06_161:
Yes. I will never do anything that would
drag your name through the mud, Lady Freya...
theater_event_23_02_06_162:
"Mud," hm... I can't imagine any child in
this city
who could do that to you or me...
theater_event_23_02_06_164:
Hey! Ottar's here!
Orario's strongest! The "Warlord" enters the
ring!!
theater_event_23_02_06_165:
Dammit...! Stop shaking...!
I won't lose! I'm gonna beat that guy!
theater_event_23_02_06_166:
Quite the excitement...
Well then, do entertain me.
theater_event_23_02_06_167: Yes, Lady Freya. I shall be going.
theater_event_23_02_06_169:
How nostalgic...
To see that look on his face again...
theater_event_23_02_07_172:
A-a Level 1 adventurer beat a Level 2...?!
How is this even possible?!
theater_event_23_02_07_173:
Ha ha ha, this is exactly what makes sumo
great.
theater_event_23_02_07_174:
Status—strength of body—matters, but if you
surpass it with skill and heart, upsets like
this can happen.
theater_event_23_02_07_175:
I see. So that's why Lord Ganesha chose sumo
for this martial arts tournament?
theater_event_23_02_07_176:
So people learn to fight without being ruled
by their Status, as first-tier adventurers
say?
theater_event_23_02_07_177:
Yeah, he is a god, after all.
I wouldn't be surprised if he had deep
motives.
theater_event_23_02_07_179:
The undisputed strongest in Orario,
the peerless "Warlord," Ottar—
theater_event_23_02_07_181:
Versus the Loki Familia executive who cleaves
through anyone in her way! "Amazon"!!
theater_event_23_02_07_182:
Ooh, I get the "yokozuna candidate"
right off the bat, huh?
But... I'm not gonna lose!
theater_event_23_02_07_183:
The arena's heating up in an instant...!
The first round's main event begins now!
theater_event_23_02_07_186:
You can't catch me!
Over here, slowpoke!
theater_event_23_02_07_187:
"Amazon" runs all over the ring!
This won't be easy to pin down...!
theater_event_23_02_07_188:
Dodging a contest of Status...
But the "Warlord's" sliding steps are—
theater_event_23_02_07_190:
Creeping up all slow like that?
You don't scare me, nyeh!
theater_event_23_02_07_192:
Huh?! How... How did I end up in the corner?!
What is this?!
theater_event_23_02_07_193:
...In the ring, even when you're not locked
up, pressure's always clashing with pressure.
theater_event_23_02_07_194:
Without even knowing it, she was pushed by
Ottar's pressure... "herded," eh?
theater_event_23_02_07_195:
I see. He turned Tiona's instincts against
her
and drove her to the edge little by little.
theater_event_23_02_07_196:
Aye... He used muscle tension and his gaze
too.
Crafty devil...!
theater_event_23_02_07_197:
That settles it—I think.
Too bad, but...
theater_event_23_02_07_201:
The winner is Ottar!!
He finishes it with an unbeatable charge!
theater_event_23_02_08_204:
Aye. Body and soul are so full of vigor
I could smash a flame rock with a slap.
theater_event_23_02_08_205: Now then, Gareth, to the ring...!
theater_event_23_02_08_206:
Gareth... That guy's seriously strong, you
know?
theater_event_23_02_08_207:
I know. That's what makes it worth entering.
...I'm off.
theater_event_23_02_08_208:
At last, the grand final bout! The winner of
this match will be sumo champion—yokozuna!!
theater_event_23_02_08_209: Both are flawless in heart, skill, and body.
theater_event_23_02_08_210:
They've been rock-steady all tournament—true
yokozuna sumo. This should be an interesting
bout—
theater_event_23_02_08_212: Oh-ho... That's a fine look on your face.
theater_event_23_02_08_213:
Who'd have thought I'd face the strongest
in the city in a match like this?
theater_event_23_02_08_215:
Heart, skill, body! I'll pour all of it into
flattening you! Here's hoping for a fiery
bout!
theater_event_23_02_08_219:
Whoa! A tremendous charge...!
Taking that head-on would—
theater_event_23_02_08_221:
H-he stopped it?! The same assault that sank
challenger after challenger in one blow—
theater_event_23_02_08_222:
Only a powerful lower body and superhuman
balance could manage that, but even so...
theater_event_23_02_08_223:
Whoa, amazing!
Is that what the shiko practice does?!
theater_event_23_02_08_224:
Two men who've spent years grinding through
plain fundamentals, colliding... Evenly
matched in technique, then.
theater_event_23_02_08_227:
A-amazing! Neither one will give an inch,
and the whole arena is shaking!
theater_event_23_02_08_228:
This is sumo! The very essence of the martial
art called a sacred rite! Splendid, both of
you!
theater_event_23_02_08_230:
Yes. It looks like simple pushing, but
they've
been probing each other the entire time.
theater_event_23_02_08_231:
Searching for each other's openings—the
"void"...
One lapse in focus would be fatal.
theater_event_23_02_08_233:
The battle's at a boil! How will it end?!
The outcome is—
theater_event_23_02_09_236:
The winner of the final is—Ottar!!
A bout truly worthy of the name "Warlord"!
theater_event_23_02_09_237:
Got impatient with the deadlock, did I...
...A total loss. Not to your Status or
skill... but to your spirit.
theater_event_23_02_09_239:
You could at least look a little happy...
You iron-faced oaf...
theater_event_23_02_09_241:
It was entertaining, but it simply
ended exactly as expected—
theater_event_23_02_09_242:
"Warlord"... No, Yokozuna Ottar!
What do you wish for as your prize?!
theater_event_23_02_09_243:
The Ganesha Familia will do everything in
its power to grant the yokozuna's wish!
theater_event_23_02_09_247:
Huh... Ah, yes...
Of course, within what we're able to grant.
theater_event_23_02_09_250:
I hear yokozuna is a title given to
one without equal under heaven...
theater_event_23_02_09_251: Then defeating the strongest is a necessity—
theater_event_23_02_09_255:
I request a bout with the god of war,
Takemikazuchi!
theater_event_23_02_09_257: I see. So that's your game.
theater_event_23_02_09_258:
Huh? What's going on?
Aren't gods supposed to be super weak...?
theater_event_23_02_09_259:
Yes. Compared to adventurers like us with
a Status, their strength and speed are
next to nothing—
theater_event_23_02_09_262:
A war god who has devoted tens of thousands
of years—or far longer—to martial arts has
skill beyond anything mortals can imagine.
theater_event_23_02_09_264:
Aye, it's like how no mortal can match
the weapons a smith god forges.
theater_event_23_02_09_265:
Even Tsubaki, a master smith, called
Lady Hephaistos a monster, didn't she?
theater_event_23_02_09_266:
Um... So that means Lord Takemikazuchi
is a martial arts monster...?
theater_event_23_02_09_269:
Don't worry.
This is sumo. Not a fight to the death.
Besides—
theater_event_23_02_09_270:
Watching the children's matches
got my blood pumping too.
theater_event_23_02_09_273: I see—so that's what you were after.
theater_event_23_02_10_274:
A sudden grand match! Yokozuna Ottar
versus the war god Takemikazuchi!!
theater_event_23_02_10_279:
...I see. Tremendous pressure.
And...not a single opening.
theater_event_23_02_10_281:
They're not not moving. They can't move.
Step carelessly into a master's range, and
you'll get eaten alive.
theater_event_23_02_10_282:
Um, couldn't he just charge in all at
once...?
theater_event_23_02_10_283: I couldn't do such a thing.
theater_event_23_02_10_284:
Facing a divine master with truly godly
skill, the crude move of overpowering him
with Status...wouldn't sit right.
theater_event_23_02_10_285:
The "Warlord" is a warrior too...
And a terribly troublesome, irrational one.
theater_event_23_02_10_287:
...Insisting on a contest of "skill and
tactics." Admirable, but...we'll get nowhere
like this, you know?
theater_event_23_02_10_288:
A contest of patience against a god who
lives for eternity is a bit of a losing
proposition, isn't it?
theater_event_23_02_10_290:
Lord Takemikazuchi could hold that flawless
stance for hours... no, days.
theater_event_23_02_10_291:
Get impatient and move, and he'll strike the
void... Yet the chance of him showing a void
himself is nil, eh...
theater_event_23_02_10_292: So there's nothing he can do...
theater_event_23_02_10_296:
You've been grappling with me in your head
over and over this whole time, haven't you?
theater_event_23_02_10_298:
I see...
But those aren't the eyes of a man giving up.
theater_event_23_02_10_300:
Then show me!
The answer you've arrived at!
theater_event_23_02_10_302: At last, the "Warlord" makes his move!!
theater_event_23_02_11_308: He created a void in a war god?!
theater_event_23_02_11_312:
That's the match!!
The winner is Lord Takemikazuchiiii!!
theater_event_23_02_11_314: To think he'd use a nekodamashi...
theater_event_23_02_11_316:
Ottar tried a surprise tactic... Right before
they locked up, he clapped his hands to try
to create a void in his opponent.
theater_event_23_02_11_317:
But...that void was far too short. Instead,
the war god struck the void in Ottar when
he was sure he'd won.
theater_event_23_02_11_318:
Yes. Lord Takemikazuchi probably "knew"—
even the surprise tactic Ottar pulled.
theater_event_23_02_11_319:
In the Far East, that tactic is called
"nekodamashi." It's a technique small
wrestlers use against stronger ones.
theater_event_23_02_11_320: I see... So others have already...
theater_event_23_02_11_321:
Yes. Because it wasn't "unknown," I could
respond. If it had been an "unknown" technique,
one not even found in the Far East...
theater_event_23_02_11_322: I might have been the one eating dirt.
theater_event_23_02_11_323:
...No. Knowledge spanning eternal history, the
foresight to prepare for a one-in-ten-thousand
chance, and the nerve to carry it out—
theater_event_23_02_11_324:
The summit of the gods...
is still far beyond me, it seems...
theater_event_23_02_12_326:
I made a disgraceful showing
before you, my goddess.
theater_event_23_02_12_328:
I won't say anything about you upholding a
warrior's pride. But why did you try to
surpass a god...
theater_event_23_02_12_329: And why did you tell me nothing?
theater_event_23_02_12_334:
Yes. I hope she doesn't have one of her
"fits" again...
theater_event_23_02_12_336:
We know she's bored out of her mind. But
finding anything to satisfy the goddess
isn't—
theater_event_23_02_12_337:
...I need you to arrange something.
Go to the Ganesha Familia.
theater_event_23_02_12_339:
Keep it secret from Lady Freya...
In order to kill her "boredom"—
theater_event_23_02_12_341:
—There was a strong opponent before me.
My warrior's blood simply boiled, telling me
to challenge him. That is all.
theater_event_23_02_12_342:
...That's no answer. Why now?
Why did you keep quiet with me...?
theater_event_23_02_12_343:
Because this was my own concern.
I intended for you to see only the result—
only victory.
theater_event_23_02_12_344: And that didn't come to pass?
theater_event_23_02_12_349:
Yes... Come to think of it, you and I once
lived days covered in "mud" and "defeat."
theater_event_23_02_12_350:
One more defeat now is hardly
something to get worked up about...is it?
theater_event_23_02_12_352:
Well, never mind. I'm not entirely satisfied,
but it was entertaining in its own way.
theater_event_23_02_12_354:
Yes. I will wash away the mud
and repay this defeat without fail.
theater_event_23_02_12_355:
Yes. I won't stand for staying defeated.
Surpass him, without fail.
theater_event_23_02_12_357:
Next time, I shall offer victory
to you, my goddess—
theater_event_23_03_01_003:
That voice—Haruhime?!
It's coming from the bath!
theater_event_23_03_01_007:
W-well... Lady Mikoto, in this heat wave,
got overheated in a scalding bath...
theater_event_23_03_01_009:
...So she got into a scalding bath to beat
the
heat, got light-headed, and collapsed...
theater_event_23_03_01_010:
I-I'm so ashamed...
Baths are a cure for all ills, you see...
theater_event_23_03_01_011:
Isn't your bath worship going a bit too
far...?
theater_event_23_03_01_012:
Ah ha ha... Well, it's been crazy hot these
past few days, so I kind of get wanting to
do something about it...
theater_event_23_03_01_013:
Whoever thinks a scalding bath will help
needs their head examined.
theater_event_23_03_01_014:
Hey, if you're hot, why not go into water
instead of a hot bath? Here.
theater_event_23_03_01_016:
They were handing 'em out in town.
Some kinda amusement place called a "pool."
theater_event_23_03_01_017:
Hmm, hmm... A "lazy river pool," a
"private pool"... There's a lot here...?
theater_event_23_03_01_018:
The guy handing 'em out said it's
something like a river or the ocean.
theater_event_23_03_01_019:
A reservoir... no, a man-made bathing
place...
something like that, perhaps?
theater_event_23_03_01_022:
So Orario finally has a pool!
Alright, let's go check it out, Bell!
theater_event_23_03_01_024:
Just come on! This is urgent!
Yeah! A paradise like that can't be
missed...!
theater_event_23_03_01_028:
Running away from me? What a naughty
goddess. I'll have to punish you.
theater_event_23_03_01_030: Heheh... hehehehe... Oh, Bell, even that...
theater_event_23_03_01_031:
We can't let a dangerous fantasy
like that come true, can we?
theater_event_23_03_01_032:
NWOOOH?! S-Supporter?!
Can you read my mind or something...?!
theater_event_23_03_01_033:
This flyer says "For a sweet summer memory!"
It's obvious you want to get cozy with
Mr. Bell by the water!
theater_event_23_03_01_034: If you're going... go with Lili, Mr. Bell!
theater_event_23_03_01_036: W-well, in that case, I'd like to...
theater_event_23_03_01_039: Couldn't we all just go together...?
theater_event_23_03_01_040:
Yeah... Go on.
Otherwise this racket'll never stop.
theater_event_23_03_01_042:
I'm good. I've still got work to finish.
Besides, we can't leave the home empty,
right?
theater_event_23_03_01_043:
But going off to have fun and
leaving just you behind...
theater_event_23_03_01_044:
Don't worry about it. If you don't go and
this place turns into a madhouse, that'd hurt
my work more. Go on.
theater_event_23_03_01_046:
Well, we're off!
Welf, take care of things!
theater_event_23_03_01_047:
Still, a "pool," huh?
The stuff the gods come up with...
theater_event_23_03_01_049:
Whoa, whoa.
If this is right, then Bell's gonna...
theater_event_23_03_02_051:
U-um... That thing with people flowing down
it like giant nagashi somen—is that a "pool"
too?
theater_event_23_03_02_052:
Yep. That's a water slide.
Zooming all the way down from the top
feels amazing!
theater_event_23_03_02_053:
How bizarre...
Truly an amusement facility built by the
gods.
theater_event_23_03_02_054:
I figured they were building something...
but I never imagined it'd be this!
theater_event_23_03_02_055: You didn't know about it, Lady Hestia?
theater_event_23_03_02_056:
I think I remember the gods' get-togethers
talking about investing in something for
summer...
